items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: I also went to do 'Memories of Josie' show

ctx.x: So then you were in Europe for eight years. If you left in '49 and got back in '57, you were there for eight years.

I wasn't there that long, I don't think I was there that long -- I went to London from Germany in '53 to do the what's-their-name shows over there -- variety television, BBC. And I also went to do "Memories of Josie" show -- I can't think who was in this
It's not that important if you don't remember his name. The important thing is how your life changed without Buck.
